# WOW Gutters Ltd

> WOW Gutters Ltd is a gutter cleaning company based in Birmingham, West Midlands, United Kingdom. It cleans gutters from the ground with a high-reach vacuum system (no ladders against the property) that reaches up to 4 storeys, with downpipe flushing and before & after photos on every job. Fully insured. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week.

## Key facts
- Name: WOW Gutters Ltd
- Address: 38 Ryland Street, Birmingham B16 8DD, United Kingdom
- Phone: 07421 433910 (+44 7421 433910)
- Email: support@wowgutters.co.uk
- Website: https://wowgutters.co.uk/
- Hours: Open 24 hours, 7 days a week
- Google rating: 4.9 stars
- Method: ground-based high-reach gutter vacuum system, no ladders, reaches up to 4 storeys
- Every gutter clean includes downpipe flushing and before & after photos
- Insurance: fully insured with public liability cover
- Same-day and next-day appointments are often available

## Prices (GBP)
- Gutter cleaning, 2-bed home: £100
- Gutter cleaning, 3-bed home: £110
- Gutter cleaning, larger detached home: £140–£210
- Fascia & soffit cleaning: from £90
- Commercial properties: quoted individually

## Areas served
Birmingham (all B postcodes), Solihull, Sutton Coldfield, Wolverhampton, Walsall, Dudley, West Bromwich, Halesowen, Stourbridge, Coventry and the wider West Midlands, plus parts of Worcestershire.
